# CHANNEL CORRECTION (T251): this KB has recorded "api.github.com answers 403 at the proxy" since
# p172 and earlier. Measured this pass: https://api.github.com/rate_limit answers HTTP 200 with
# core limit 15000 / remaining 15000. What refuses is every path outside the session's BOUND
# repositories, and it refuses with its own message: "This GitHub API path is not available:
# sessions are bound to their configured repositories. Use repository-scoped endpoints". So
# repos/moodle/moodle is 403 and search/repositories is 403, but the cause is session repo-binding,
# not a blanket proxy denial -- which means the remedy exists (attach the repo) where it matters.
# ALSO MEASURED: github.com HTML is 403 to curl while raw.githubusercontent.com is 200 and
# git ls-remote/clone over https succeeds. Four channels, four different answers.
